To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we present a new dataset of river discharge, stage and water temperature for the Akuliarusiarsiup Kuua (AK) river in Southwest Greenland; (2) we quantify uncertainties in discharge measurements for this dataset and show that uncertainties in discharge are two to four-fold larger than previous estimates for other Greenland rivers; and (3) we make this data publicly available to the research community.
We present a new high-resolution hydrological dataset from previously un-monitored sites in the Kangerlussauq area in Southwest Greenland.
